name: Bubble Critter Garden
description: A miniature magical arcade pavilion: a glossy pastel hex-bubble board under curved textured timber, flowered vines and warm lanterns. Seven animated textured critters welcome visitors onto a layered garden island with a cherry tree, stone path, clover, butterflies, a small waterfall and a flower bubble launcher. Enter to play the full bubble shooter.

credits.work: Original pavilion, creatures, procedural PBR atlases and geometry
